scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @bdg-pods/api" "npm run dev -w @bdg-pods/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bdg-pods/shared && npm run build -w @bdg-pods/api && npm run build -w @bdg-pods/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @bdg-pods/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @bdg-pods/web --if-present
